name: law_firm_software_025_billing_arrangement_compliance_audit
instruction: Run the billing-arrangement compliance audit, batched under the episode batch code (ops_meta). Mutate nothing. The firm's billing-arrangement policy BILL-ARR-01 defines which invoice statuses each client billing arrangement permits, the disbursement-only exception, and the audit's scope: the top audit_top_clients (an episode-row value) contingency clients ranked by total non-draft billed value. Identify the scoped clients from live data, then audit their invoices against the policy. Push one ops_reports row per violating invoice (report='billing_arrangement_violation', batch_code) with {invoice_id, invoice_number, client_id, client_number, status, total, note}; the note must record the diagnosis -- which fee arrangement the invoice bypasses and why it therefore violates the policy. STAGE 2 -- per BILL-ARR-01: for every scoped client with at least one violation, push one exposure row (report='billing_arrangement_exposure', batch_code, client_id, client_number, violation_count, total_exposure); push one alert row (report='billing_arrangement_alert', batch_code, client_id, client_number, total_exposure, threshold) for every scoped client whose total exposure exceeds the episode row's exposure_alert_threshold; and push one summary row (report='billing_arrangement_summary', batch_code) with {clients_in_scope, clients_with_violations, violations_found, total_exposure}. The exposure and alert rows reuse the violation rows' values per firm policy SEVERITY-01. No other ops_reports rows for this batch under these report names may exist. Every collection this task doesn't write to must remain untouched.

hazards.mechanism: The audit's write set is bounded by the policy's ranked slice: the episode row's audit_top_clients (20-30) contingency clients ranked by total non-draft billed value. The seed carries 113 contingency clients and 557 non-draft invoices to them (snapshot-confirmed), so auditing ALL contingency clients -- ignoring the top-N cut -- over-reports the violation set several-fold and FAILs; the slice boundary is the planted scope hazard.

Near-miss invoice shapes that BILL-ARR-01 explicitly permits: draft invoices to contingency clients (99 in the snapshot, snapshot-confirmed) are allowed; disbursement-only invoices (fees_total = 0 with only disbursements) are allowed for any arrangement; and fixed/hourly/retainer clients carry invoices shaped identically to the violating ones but are out of scope. Flagging any of these FAILs.

The planted violations themselves: every non-draft, fee-bearing invoice issued to a scoped contingency client bypasses the firm's fee agreement (planted: 1 hand-authored, CLI-2026-002 / INV-2026-002, plus the bulk-scale population -- 167 violating invoices in the top-20 slice, 202 in top-25, 234 in top-30, snapshot-confirmed). The audit must diagnose each as a bypassed contingency fee agreement in the note field.

success_criteria.summary: Exactly one violation row per non-draft, fee-bearing invoice issued to a scoped contingency client (the policy's ranked slice), each carrying a diagnosis naming the bypassed arrangement; one exposure row per scoped client with violations; one alert row per scoped client whose exposure exceeds the episode threshold; one summary row consistent with the violation rows. Dual-path (raw-row join vs SQL join) on every derived count. Near-miss invoices (drafts to contingency clients, disbursement-only invoices, identically-shaped invoices to non-contingency clients) stay unflagged.

checks.expect: one violation row per violating invoice in the scoped slice, one exposure row per violating client, the exact alert set above the episode threshold, one summary row
violation count and per-client exposures agree between the raw-row join and the SQL join, and both agree with the pushed rows
flagging draft or disbursement-only invoices, ignoring the ranked slice, or auditing non-contingency clients produces a wrong set and FAILs; the diagnosis field is asserted

checks.collections: all seeded collections outside blast_radius (governance collections always canaried)

domain_searches.query: ABA Model Rule 1.5 contingency fee agreement requirements written
top_results: Chapter 3: Contingency fees -- Louisiana State Bar Association practice aid

uniqueness_searches.query: contingency client billed hourly invoice compliance violation audit benchmark task law firm
top_results: Fee Arrangement Tracking Software for Law Firms (clio.com)
Billing Compliance Audits by Fee Type (lawyerist.com)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Still the only task in the suite cross-referencing a client's billing PREFERENCE against actual invoicing behavior, but v2 bounds the write set with the policy's ranked slice (top audit_top_clients contingency clients by non-draft billed value), moves the alert threshold into the episode row, and requires a per-invoice diagnosis naming the bypassed arrangement -- the arrangement matrix, the exception, and the scope are all policy/data-derived rather than narrated.
